claim_boundary: This protocol implements only the algebraic completion of a pre-existing, independently source-bound density-response covariance. Unit tests use synthetic matrices. No physical response-kernel asset, MACE production calculation, PCM calculation, QM solvent-physics calculation, force, PES, solvation free energy, or experimental accuracy result is performed.

construction.name: route2-v0-response-kernel-completion-v1
construction.baseline: C0 is supplied by the caller in one declared coefficient/dual pairing and must be symmetric positive semidefinite with exact neutral response C0 q = 0.
construction.moment_constraint: A maps density coefficients to stacked atomic dipoles; W maps a molecular dipole to the same stacked atomic convention with G W = I. The frozen target covariance is Gamma = W alpha_theta W^T.
construction.completion: For S0 = A C0 A^T positive definite and L = C0 A^T S0^-1, C = C0 - L S0 L^T + L Gamma L^T. It preserves C >= 0, A C A^T = Gamma, M C M^T = alpha_theta, and C q = 0.
construction.scalar: On Ran(C), F_RK(dc) = 0.5 dc^T C^+ dc gives dc/df = -C. Kernel-null modes are exact constraints, not large-curvature or eigenvalue-clipping repairs.

required_structural_gates: C0 is symmetric positive semidefinite and has exact charge-neutral response in the declared coefficient/dual pairing.
The baseline atom-dipole covariance S0 = A C0 A^T is positive definite; a singular S0 is rejected rather than pseudoinverted.
The frozen atomic partition sums exactly to the molecular dipole.
The completed C is symmetric positive semidefinite and exactly preserves charge neutrality, atomic covariance, and molecular polarizability.
The curvature is the Moore-Penrose inverse only on the declared support; the total-charge row plus returned independent null rows span every null response mode exactly.
A future same-basis KKT must bind C, C^+, c0, and the physical continuum to one scalar before any physics or accuracy calculation.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not invent C0 from the rejected MACE fixed point, a Gaussian or radial width, an error-selected atom partition, or a continuum receiver map.
Do not use a pseudoinverse to repair a singular baseline atom covariance or clip a negative response eigenvalue.
Do not select any kernel, cavity, continuum, radius, dispersion term, or numerical rank from FreeSolv, MNSol, or another solvation error.
Do not call a per-molecule runtime QM response oracle a faster production Route-2 method without an end-to-end speed certificate.
Do not call this structural kernel a physical response model, a PCM result, a force/PES result, or an accuracy result.
physical_binding_required_before_any_acc: An immutable, independently source-bound C0 with coefficient/dual, geometry, charge, and rigid-motion provenance.
A same-basis permanent source c0 and energy-conjugate smooth continuum with complete coordinate derivatives.
The frozen twelve-record, ten-actual-functional-group QM density, MEP, induced-dipole, reaction-potential, force, and runtime gates without experimental solvation labels.
Source-complete physical solvent assets for the requested multi-solvent and custom-solvent protocol.
The immutable historical FreeSolv10 all-record maximum-error test, then broad development, confirmation, and disjoint blind experimental panels.
decision_rule: Failure of any source, symmetry, positivity, support, common-scalar, force, runtime, physical-solvent, or all-record accuracy gate rejects the candidate. It never authorizes fitting, retraining, calibration, response modification, radial-width selection, cavity/radius tuning, or per-record model selection.
